summary: Verified the /services page top-clipping fix on both desktop (1280x800) and mobile (393x852). The hero (Briefcase icon tile + h1 'Local services for hosts & guests') is fully visible below the fixed global navigation on both viewports, and the rest of the page (What you'll find here, categories grid, contact form) still renders correctly with no extra blank gap or double-stacking.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is implemented correctly using the same `paddingTop: 'var(--nav-h, 68px)'` pattern as Stays.jsx — consistent with the rest of the codebase.
Navigation.js publishes --nav-h via ResizeObserver, which correctly reports 68px on desktop and 111px on mobile (taller due to the secondary tab row). The fix is responsive and not hardcoded.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Services page hero clipping fix verified. Desktop: nav_bottom=68, icon_top=164, h1_top=252. Mobile: nav_bottom=111, icon_top=175, h1_top=263. All hero elements clear of nav on both viewports. Other page sections render correctly.
